items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: We rehearsed with the big band.

ctx.x: He used to be a great lead player, and he lived in Hollywood, in Los Angeles too, and so he worked the studio and did a lot of lead playing and stuff like that. And then he went to New York and that’s when we saw him again.
We rehearsed with the big band.
We rehearsed with the big band and we recorded with him. Those dates were set up, where we featured him. That was on “Homeward Bound.”
